_comment: Read by the R45 driver (lab/optimize_settings.py) for R38 and R39. Keys and types are documented in the note's 'Approach' section; _comment keys are for people. Times in 'schedule' are ET clock times on the night of 2026-10-10.
decision: Ax 1.x (ax-platform 1.3.1, BoTorch, method fast with qLogNEI), asynchronous one trial per free worker, warm-started from the baseline and four prior arms instead of Sobol points, repeats inside one spawn, trials grouped by card state; inference (R38) then training (R39) on pod D (plan B, the default), R39 on pod C at the same time only with Ilan's go (plan A: teacher share at most 0.63, placement override); expected win after about 5 evaluations when a prior is right (p about 0.69), about 17 when not, plus 6 confirmation spawns.

tool.name: ax-platform
tool._comment: R45 pins the exact ax-platform and botorch versions in lab/requirements-optimize.txt; nothing goes into pyproject.toml.

generation_strategy.fallback_when: after 10 completed trials, if the model's leave-one-out fit is poor and at most two parameters show an effect
generation_strategy._comment: No Sobol points: the lane's initial_arms are attached first (attach_baseline, attach_trial) and count as initialization; then get_next_trials(max_trials=1) per free worker, other trials still RUNNING (pending).

workers.name: pod-c

conditional_lanes.precondition: Ilan's go to restart the teacher with GPU_UTIL at most 0.63 (about 297 s with no teacher) and to override the placement check for R39's slot (python -m lab slot request --override); then FO6 must show at least 17.05 GiB free (13.05 GiB LoRA budget plus 4 GiB host reserve, lab/refine/research/plumbing/placement.md)

never: restarting the teacher without Ilan's go

workers.name: pod-e
workers.precondition: AMD grants a third account tonight and the stock build and checkpoint are installed (R30's scripts)

workers.name: pod-f
workers.precondition: AMD grants a fourth account tonight; more than four inference workers is not planned (SCOOT saw quality drop above 4 parallel suggestions)

driver_host.one_inference_worker: pod-d: lab/optimize_settings.py runs locally on the pod, as R45 is built
driver_host.several_inference_workers: this machine: one Ax experiment for the lane, a hub runner per worker (python -m lab.controller run-script --account <letter> ...)

group_by_state.principle: trials that need the same card state run back to back, so the card changes state as few times as possible

inference.state: one server configuration (all ten R35 parameters)
inference.block: every restart-free measurement of that configuration runs in its one spawn: batch 1 x 3 requests for the objective, batch 8 when the arm is in the current top 3, extra requests for a finalist
inference.order: by compile class: every second trial a worker asks for is asked with fixed_parameters = that worker's last compile class, so each class is restarted cold once and reused warm once

training.state: one loaded process: model, data and the process-level parameters
training.block: trials that differ only in in-process parameters run back to back in that process once the trainer can change them without reloading; until then one process per trial

card.rule: one lane at a time per card; the blocks of a lane run back to back

inference.search_space_status: on main since PR #235 (99db20c), schema atlas.searchspace.v1; R45 reads or converts it
inference.correctness_gate: R21 on the best arm before it is declared, and on any arm with num_speculative_tokens > 0 before its speed counts

sources: GPU Queue row R30 (2026-10-10, pod D, 523 s cold)
GPU Queue row R18 (2026-10-10, pod D, 294 s warm)

finalist.when: the arm is among the model's top 3 when it is asked for

launch_extra.if: FO1 shows a shorter restart and no change in decode_tok_s at batch 1 and 8
launch_extra.applies_to: the baseline and every trial alike; merged into the trial's own --compilation-config JSON (cudagraph_mode NONE captures nothing)

repeat_policy.observation: median of the per-request decode rates (decode_tok_s.b1) and the row's joules_per_token.b1
repeat_policy.sem: R45's MEDIAN_SEM_FACTOR x sd / sqrt(3) of the per-request decode rates; joules_per_token.b1 takes the same relative SEM because decode power is near constant (lab/README.md: 120 W average, 129 W peak)
repeat_policy.between_spawn_noise: measured only by FO3 and the confirmation spawns

after_first_request.rule: stop the spawn after the first measured request when its decode tok/s is below 0.5 x the baseline's median
after_first_request.report: complete_trial with that request and an SEM of 2 x the baseline's per-request sd

early_stop.ready_timeout: mark_trial_failed when the server is not ready within ready_timeout_s for its class

budget.queue_justification: each trial restarts a 27B server (295 to 523 s, rows R18 and R30), so the run cannot be split into 15-minute slots; the driver resumes from its trial files between 60-minute slots

confirmation.order: best, baseline, best, baseline, best, baseline on the same pod
confirmation.test: one-sided 95 percent on joules_per_token.b1, power 0.8 for a gain of about two spawn standard deviations; low_confidence until 5 spawns per arm (lab/machine/verdict.py MIN_RUNS_PER_ARM)

training.search_space_status: on main since PR #238 (86f7b8d), Ax-config style; R45 reads or converts it
outcome_constraints: peak_mem_gb at most the worker's free memory minus 3 GiB (pod C: from FO6)
last_loss within the baseline's run-to-run noise; R39 checks loss parity on the best arm

repeat_policy.sem: R45's MEDIAN_SEM_FACTOR x sd / sqrt(15) of the per-step samples/s
repeat_policy.between_run_noise: measured only by the confirmation runs

after_steps.rule: stop when samples/s over steps 2 to 5 is below 0.5 x the baseline's

contamination.pod-c: drop steps that overlap a teacher request (vLLM /metrics num_requests_running above 0 at the step's start or end) and report how many were dropped

budget.queue_justification: each trial is a 20-step LoRA run of about 11 minutes at the old chip's rate; the driver resumes from its trial files between 60-minute slots

confirmation.order: best, baseline, best, baseline, best, baseline on the same pod
confirmation.test: one-sided 95 percent on samples_per_s; loss parity checked on the best arm

kernel.task: kernel lane, feeding R33, R47 and the kernels track's KE experiments
kernel.approach: measure cheaply, fit a cost model, score the whole space against it, measure only the top k

targets.name: w4a16_decode_gemv
targets.where: vLLM's W4A16 Triton path on gfx1151 at the teacher's batch-1 GEMV shapes
targets.shapes_from: the stock teacher's serve log and R47's decode profile

targets.name: gated_delta_rule_chunk
targets.where: flash-linear-attention chunk_gated_delta_rule forward and backward for the training lane (R36 TS7)

targets.name: causal_conv1d
targets.where: the causal-conv1d kernel for the training lane (R36 TS10)

measure.compile: ahead of the GPU slot on the pod's CPU, in parallel; configs that fail to compile or run out of resources count as infinitely slow

model.library: scikit-learn or xgboost on CPU, user install, never in pyproject.toml
model.transfer: later shapes of the same kernel start from this model with about 100 measurements each

features: vgprs, spills and lds_bytes from the compiled kernel
occupancy in waves per SIMD on gfx1151 (1536 VGPRs per SIMD in wave32, granule 24, at most 16 waves; LDS 64 KiB per workgroup, 128 KiB per WGP)
shape M, N, K and group size

search.method: enumerate the whole space against the model below 1e6 configs; evolutionary search above

kill.on_low_spearman: measure exhaustively if the space fits the slot, else stop the lane for that kernel
kill.correctness: the best config must pass R21's per-shape test (V2) before its time counts

kernel.measurements_per_slot_est: about 2 shapes at 1,000 measurements from scratch, or about 10 shapes at 100 with the transferred model
reuse: triton.autotune with prune_configs_by perf_model and top_k (Triton 3.5.1 on the pods)
tritonBLAS's analytical model as a seed for half-precision GEMMs, once checked on gfx1151
not tonight: TVM MetaSchedule (gfx1151 support unverified), GEAK and other LLM kernel agents (CDNA-focused, need an LLM service)
